text_block_list.text:
The Japanese Derby, a truly special race. 
Feeling completely out of place as 
expected, Hishi Miracle's cold feet have 
gotten the better of her.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Today's stars were Tanino Gimlet and 
Symboli Kris S. I decided to just treat 
myself as a guest appearance.
